_readme: The oil, and the only gift on this path. The flask can be taken in the first minute of the
game, before the player has any idea a lantern exists - so the hermit says what it is FOR.
An item obtainable before its purpose is statable has to carry its purpose at pickup.
The gift is on a CHOICE, never on a node: a node has no condition and no memory, so a
conversation looped through one would hand over a second flask. The idiom is set_flag +
hidden_if_flag on the same choice. Both replies END the talk - a choice line cannot be
escaped with cancel, so a conversation that looped back through one would have no way out.

greet.speaker: Hermit
greet.text: Nobody comes down here for the view.

ask.speaker: Hermit
ask.text: There is oil on the shelf. The keep's lantern drank its last flask years before the gate was barred, and I have kept the rest since. More than one person needs.

choices.text: Could I have some of that oil?

gave.speaker: Hermit
gave.text: Take a flask. Mind the wick - it catches faster than you expect.

passing.speaker: Hermit
passing.text: Everyone is, eventually. The shelf keeps.
